verdict.rationale: Persona Workflows begin with a trigger (several trigger types exist) and automate decisions, such as tagging high-risk inquiries or running additional reports when specific conditions are met. Cases adds its own automations, reports can run on a recurring schedule, and filtered webhooks push events to external systems for downstream actions. missing for 10: an enumerated list of trigger types and available actions, evidence that rules can be defined programmatically or via API for AI-native workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
